prereg/reviewbench v7 — for audit sign-off. Upstream ReviewBench sha e7d0683507b227ff20a9230120240d8ab2a97bbe. Nothing has been judged. v6 = v5 + audit conditions B1–B7, R-a–R-c (inbox/swarm-123021-1nwp-audit/audit-signoff-v1 and -addendum). v7 = v6 + ONE clause in §3 (approximate-line citations), added after reading unjudged lens output and before any judge call; disclosed in §3.

1 REVIEWER (unchanged): devkit four-lens correctness cascade via external/pr-run.mts + scale/lens-run.mts (adapter external/reviewbench-bench.mts). Model claude-haiku-5-5, CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL=medium, production issue cap 3/lens, arm `whole`. Code at eadfcdc2 or a descendant on our branches; every run output records model claude-haiku-5-5 and a gateHash identical across the runs that are compared. Worktree at merge-base(base, head) with diff = local `git diff base...head` staged (what ReviewBench's try-agent.sh hands reviewers). ONE in-process review config for every PR, shared with prereg/aacr: include **/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,mjs,cjs,mts,cts,svelte,py,go,cs,rs,java,kt,swift,rb,php,sh}; no test exclusion (correctness is domain 'all': gate-engine/review/scope/policy.mts).
 B6 environment: each lens judge runs with cwd = the PR worktree, tools Read/Grep/Glob (reviewers.mts allowedToolsFor). The codebase MCP (searchCode) is ABSENT from the judge profile (probe logs "named-agent MCP profile missing codebase — DEGRADED"); it is never pointed at devkit or another repo. Cross-file labels are reachable only through Read/Grep; the probe must show one lens transcript reading a non-diff file of the PR repo, else cross-file results are reported as unreachable-by-construction.

2 JUDGE: ReviewBench's own `npm run judge`, unmodified, --provider openrouter --model anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 (leaderboard judge, registered via PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=~/.devkit/research/reviewbench/judge-cfg). Unavailable => stop and re-ask; no substitute. Prompt fingerprint and golden hash read from results.json and identical across compared runs. No devkit matcher.
 B7: `--ingest` is NEVER passed (it writes novel TPs into golden/). sha256 of golden/ (tar of sorted files) is recorded before and after every judged run; a change voids that run.

3 LOCATION AND WITHHELD FINDINGS (B1): location = the FIRST file:line mention (scale/labels.mts extractRanges) that resolves to a staged path (resolveToStaged) AND carries a line; a range a-b exports start_line=a, end_line=b. v7: an optional `~` between the colon and the line number is tolerated (`file:~a-b` => start a, end b; `file:~a` => start=end=a); nothing else about the citation grammar changes. Disclosure: this clause was added after S1 r1 lens output (no judge call, no score) showed claude-haiku-5-5 writing approximate lines as `file:~640-660`: of the first 26 issues, 6 were withheld (23%), 4 of them tilde citations carrying a usable line. Both counts are reported per run: withheld under the v6 grammar and under v7. No such mention => WITHHELD, never matched, never given an invented line; counted per run as withheldNoFile / withheldFileNoLine. Also counted per run: crossFile = exported findings whose text names >=2 staged files (a same-file matcher cannot credit the second file). Precision as judged AND worst-case (withheld counted FP). Withheld > 20% of issues in a run => protocol caveat beside its numbers. Message = full lens issue text prefixed "[<lens>]".
 B4: before any scored run the probe checks 5 sampled exported findings land on the cited code in the head file; a miss rate >1/5 stops the run until the line mapping is fixed.

4 EXCLUSIONS (out of the denominator, COUNTED and named by anonymised id): (a) base or head does not fetch; (b) reviewer selects 0 files (S1 dry-run: 1 PR); (c) prepare fails (diff will not apply on the merge base); (d) arm with >10% lens tasks inconclusive => FAILED ON PROTOCOL, no recall number; (e) PR the judge cannot finish after one resume. PRs with 0 qualifying labels stay in for precision. Labels on files outside the §1 scope stay in the denominator, partitioned not-in-scope, in-scope recall beside it.

5 CATCH AND HEADLINE (R-a): qualifying label = golden tp_fp=tp, category correctness or reliability, scope introduced-by-pr. Caught = in covered_golden_indices of >=1 candidate in results.details.json (the judge's raw match = grounded recall). HEADLINE = grounded recall. Augmented recall/precision use a Sonnet 5 classifier (same family) and are reported only as secondary context, never as catches. Correctness, reliability and union separately. Per-label partition: not-in-scope / cap-omitted-or-truncated (60 KB evidence cap) / shown-in-full. Issue-cap ceiling (12 findings per whole-diff PR) per band.
 B2 family split: EVERY recall number is reported twice — labels whose golden `producer` contains "claude" and labels that do not. Only the non-Claude figure may be quoted as an absolute recall; the gap is the measured self-preference.

6 STRATA: size = materialised base...head diff (numstat added+removed lines, files); manifest sizes are not used (they disagree: evidence/reviewbench-manifest-sizes). Line bands <200 / 200-999 / 1000-2999 / >=3000; file bands <5 / 5-14 / 15-39 / >=40; golden context_required. Cross-PR bands are DESCRIPTIVE ONLY.

7 FALSE POSITIVES: grounded precision (matched_tp / exported), count of candidates matched to a golden FP (known-false finding raised), worst-case precision, augmented precision as secondary.

8 SETS AND RUNS:
 S1 (R-c) = 25 test PRs: SMOKE AND NOISE TEST ONLY, no recall claim. 2 reviewer runs (separate checkpoints), each judged once; r1 judged twice = judge-noise band.
 S2 = non-test-set TS/JS PRs (manifest language) with >=1 qualifying label, all materialised and sized with no model call, then 6 per line band by ascending sha256("rb-prereg-v1|"+pr_key); a band with <6 eligible takes all and says so => <=24 PRs. 2 reviewer runs, each judged once.
 S3 contingent (after S2 passes protocol): chunk:400 arm on S2 PRs >=1000 lines, same diffs, 2 runs. R-b: compared against the equal-cost control = UNION of the two whole runs (no extra calls), and split by PR evidence <=60 KB vs >60 KB (above the cap `whole` is truncated). Own call count on the board first.
 Noise band (B3) = range over runs + PR-clustered bootstrap 95% CI (external/reviewbench-score.mts clusterBootstrap, 2000 iters, seed 1). No single-run result is reported.

9 PLANNED CALLS: S1 dry-run = 96 lens tasks per run (24 PRs prepared), 192 for 2 runs; judge sessions S1 = 24 x 3 judged runs x 2 (matcher + classifier) = 144. S2: 24 x 4 x 2 = 192 lens tasks, judge 96 sessions. Restated on the board before each stage.

10 COMMITTED: counts, band tables, anonymised ids (sha256 of pr_key), upstream sha, judge id, prompt fingerprint, golden hash; this file as docs/benchmarks/external/reviewbench/pre-registration.md. Report reducer: external/reviewbench-report.mts (assertCountsOnlyJson on output).

11 USE LIMIT (B5) AND WHAT REVIEWBENCH CANNOT TELL US: the PRs predate the model's training cutoff and the goldens are public, so numbers rank arms of the SAME model on the SAME PRs only; no comparison with the leaderboard, other families or other benchmarks. 1,434/2,623 golden TPs (575/1,068 correctness) are Claude-written, the context tag comes from a Claude classifier and the judge is Claude — recall on Claude-written labels is likely inflated (B2 measures it), and a blind spot shared by Claude models is invisible. Goldens are not exhaustive, and the audit's pre-run read found some labels a careful reviewer rightly skips (1 of 8 miscategorised, 1 speculative on an unchanged line), so misses include defensible passes; audit samples ~10 catches and ~10 misses per run. Issue cap 3/lens may bound big-PR recall. No codebase MCP in the judge profile (B6). Size bands across PRs confound size with repo/language/label density; only S3 measures capacity.

v8 — JUDGE TRANSPORT (§2), owner-approved 2026-10-11 after OpenRouter credit ran out mid S1 r2 (6 PRs failed with HTTP 402). Nothing else changes.
 Judge = ReviewBench's own `npm run judge` at e7d0683 plus [`claude-cli-transport.patch`](claude-cli-transport.patch), run as `--provider claude-cli --model claude-sonnet-5`, so judging runs on a Claude subscription. Same model, system prompts, matcher and classifier prompts (prompt hashes b47f849fa616 / 366ed8de8403 on both transports) and turn order; golden/ hash 1e8eb5f8d1aa before and after every run; never --ingest. Judge id claude-cli/claude-sonnet-5, so a checkpoint never mixes transports.
 Transport differences: pi thinkingLevel low/medium -> `claude -p --effort low/medium`; `--safe-mode`, so no CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills or MCP from the judged repo; classifier tools read/grep/find/ls -> Read/Grep/Glob in the same checkout; each turn resumes a fork of the last good turn, so a failed turn retries from unchanged history (waits 30-300 s ride out a usage-limit account switch); the CLI runs under the default config dir, because a host harness's config dir added session context that the judge answered instead of the prompt (0/4 vs 4/4 JSON replies on the same prompt); a JSON-expected reply holding no JSON object is re-asked at most twice. A PR with any unparsable turn fails whole and is re-judged on resume, so no partial PR is scored.
 Transport check, before any S2 number: the 6 S1 PRs r2 never finished were judged over claude-cli for r1 (already judged over OpenRouter) and r2. On r1: 17/17 candidates covered the same golden set, 8/8 goldens caught on both, 9/9 classifier tp/fp verdicts equal. S1 r2 is therefore mixed transport (18 OpenRouter + 6 claude-cli); S2 is claude-cli only.
